source.title: Shinners & Mahler's Illustrated Flora of North Central Texas
source.authors: Diggs, G. M. Jr.; Lipscomb, B. L.; O'Kennon, R. J.

morphology_documented.bark: Smooth or flaking bark mottled white tan and green
morphology_documented.leaves: Alternate large simple leaf blades to ca. 35 × 35 cm, palmately lobed or coarsely toothed, petiole hollow at base and enclosing axillary bud; initially stellate-hairy, sparsely hairy with age
morphology_documented.twigs: Large connate stipules encircle twig and drop as leaves expand
morphology_documented.flowers: Staminate and pistillate in separate drooping spherical heads on same tree, long-peduncled
morphology_documented.fruit: Pistillate fruit heads 3–4 cm diameter, each small indehiscent one-seeded fruit with basal tuft of tan hairs

source_scope_note: Genus/key traits explicitly identified; modern secondary evidence separately cited; no unsupported species characters inferred.
